text.p: Average yields at auctions of nine-month treasury bills edged down and 12-month yields were unchanged from the last sales, a central bank statement said on Friday.
Nine-month bills slipped to 28.14 percent from 28.18 percent and 12-month bills were unchanged at 30.36 percent.
The central bank cancelled an auction for six-month T-bills without explanation.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared with the last issue, were as follows:
Auction Number 286 282
Issue date July 4, 1997 July 3, 1997
Maturity date April 3, 1998 April 3, 1998
Denominations 100 hryvnia 100 hryvnia
Issue volume 15.50 million UAH 20.00 million UAH
Amount sold 15.50 million UAH 20.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 12.80 million UAH 16.52 million UAH
Average yield 28.14 percent 28.18 percent
Average price 82.61 hryvnia 82.59 hryvnia
Cut-off price 82.61 hryvnia 82.59 hryvnia
The central bank sold 155,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for July 8.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared with the last issue, were as follows:
Auction Number 287 283
Issue date July 4, 1997 July 3, 1997
Maturity date July 3, 1998 July 3, 1998
Denominations 100 hryvnia 100 hryvnia
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 35.08 million UAH 86.75 million UAH
Actual amount raised 26.92 million UAH 66.59 million UAH
Average yield 30.36 percent 30.36 percent
Average price 76.76 hryvnia 76.76 hryvnia
Cut-off price 76.75 hryvnia 76.75 hryvnia
The central bank sold 350,770 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for July 8.
